name: Marcus Cole
bio: Former collegiate football player with 12 years of coaching experience. CSCS and USAW certified. Specializes in building raw strength and explosive power.

name: Aria Chen
bio: RYT-500 certified with 8 years of teaching experience. Blends traditional yoga philosophy with modern movement science to help clients move better and recover faster.

name: Dex Morales
bio: Competitive amateur boxer turned fitness coach. Known for high-energy classes that push limits while keeping form locked in. 6 years coaching experience.

name: Suki Tanaka
bio: Classically trained Pilates instructor with a background in professional dance. Focuses on core stability, posture correction, and graceful movement.

name: Jamal Wright
bio: CrossFit Level 3 trainer and former regional competitor. Believes in building practical, real-world fitness that transfers to everyday life. 9 years in the game.

name: Nina Volkov
bio: Completed 3 Ironman triathlons and coaches endurance athletes at every level. Her spin classes are legendary — equal parts playlist curation and suffering.
